analysis: The trial succeeded with authoritative macro validation HR@10=0.5662: Movies_and_TV 0.6400, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.5900, Electronics 0.3800, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.6550. This exceeds the supplied 0.5637 reference by 0.0025 but remains 0.0138 below 0.5800. The modest gain supports further investigation of ranking-aligned supervision, but one seeded trial does not establish a reliable improvement. Electronics remains the weakest category. Training consumed 553.21 GPU-seconds; no test metrics were provided.
code_summary: One independently trained masked transformer per category, with 96-dimensional embeddings, two transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.2, and sequence length 64. A final mask token produces the query; scores use tied item embeddings plus jointly trained item biases. Clean final-query supervision uses top-10 discount-weighted pairwise logistic loss over 256 shared uniform negative draws, excluding training-history items and target collisions before ranking. Historical reconstruction cross-entropy and detached-clean-view consistency regularization remain unchanged. AdamW trains with seed 42; validation selects one checkpoint per category. The exported predictor preserves dataset routing and strictly loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category, with no ensemble or separately fitted scoring component.
